scope: Four matched cases, hour8 and hour9, native full campaign replay; all reached mission winners and terminal rounds match original evaluation.

dialogue.text: That landing lamp has burned every night since I was a boy. Last night it went out. So did every window on the other bank.
And the ferry?
Still tied up over there. We’ll have to take the fords round the island.
The wind’s coming down the valley. That mist is creeping the other way.
You studied fog?
A whole winter at the Collegium. This wasn’t in the lessons.
Find the ferryman. Quickly. Whatever happened, he’s alone over there.

dialogue.speaker: Scout
dialogue.text: You’re the patrol? We’ve been checking the western woods. Nobody has come back across the ford. I’ll show you the way.
Bats! Keep them off the horses!
There are accounts of swarms like this in the old siege chronicles. I thought the writers were embellishing.

dialogue.speaker: Ferryman
dialogue.text: Over here! They’re at the door! For the love of anything living, get them away from the door!
Shields up. Make them come to us.

dialogue.speaker: Ferryman
dialogue.text: I thought the door would give before anyone heard me.
We saw the landing lantern go out. Where is everyone?

dialogue.speaker: Ferryman
dialogue.text: The dead took them. Went house to house, drove them out onto the eastern road. I barred this door and put the lamp out.
Stay inside. We’ll light the villages and see what’s left.
Who gave the skeletons their orders? Did you see him?

dialogue.speaker: Ferryman
dialogue.text: Something in a robe. Bare bone where its face should be. The other dead stood still when it spoke.
A lich. Those villages weren’t attacked for their coin.

dialogue.speaker: Ferryman
dialogue.text: Then bring my neighbors back. And watch the houses. I heard things moving inside after the people were gone.
Spiders! Back from the doorway!
Cellar spiders. We raised them at the Collegium. All the food in the world wouldn’t make them grow like this.
